Mod.Name: Fraud Detection
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Knows when a label lies. Hover an item: anything that isn't what it claims (counterfeit cigarettes, stamps and injectors, impure water and chemicals, worn equipment, ingots, wine...) shows what it really is and its real value change. Inspecting a counterfeit opens with the right issue already ticked, so you just press Confront.
